descriptive payload at most; none can select a target.  The exact window
identity is checked before and after every inspection.

names are redacted before matching or serialization.
Mutations accept only a short-lived, single-use element capability emitted by

selectors, HWNDs or raw RuntimeIds.  The provider re-finds the element,

because a generic invocation has no deterministic postcondition.
``uia.set_value`` uses ValuePattern only after checking IsEnabled,
IsPassword, IsOffscreen and CurrentIsReadOnly.  Dispatch is not considered
proof: an Invoker verifier opens an independent COM session, re-finds the same
element and compares a freshly read CurrentValue with the exact requested
string.  Any missing or contradictory observation stays inconclusive.
The state actions ``uia.toggle``, ``uia.select`` and
``uia.expand_collapse`` follow the same model: they request one explicit final
state through TogglePattern, SelectionItemPattern or ExpandCollapsePattern,
then independently re-open and read that pattern's current state.  They never
cycle or guess from an indeterminate state.

uninitializes COM in the Invoker worker thread that owns the controls.  Its
